articles.title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
articles.description: It follows the Anthropic CEO's calls for a slowdown in AI development - but in a way that prevents China from pulling ahead in the race.
articles.titleJa: 中国、AIに関する「悪意ある競争」という考え方を批判
articles.summary: 中国政府がAI開発における「悪意ある競争」との見方を否定。Anthropic CEOがAI開発の減速を提唱するも、中国の優位を防ぐ形で行われることに対し、中国は反発を示している。

articles.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
articles.description: The former UK PM said: "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning".
articles.titleJa: ボリス・ジョンソン氏ら欧州高官が駅を去った直後、ロシアがウクライナの列車を攻撃
articles.summary: ボリス・ジョンソン前英首相ら欧州高官が駅を出た直後、ロシア軍がウクライナの列車を攻撃。プーチンがポーランド国境の停車中の機関車を爆破した動機は不明だとジョンソン氏は述べた。

articles.title: Thousands demand end to violence in Mexican cartel hotspot
articles.description: Culiacán has seen violence skyrocket since a feud broke out between two rival factions of the Sinaloa cartel.
articles.titleJa: メキシコのカルテル活動地域で、数千人が暴力の終結を要求
articles.summary: シナロア・カルテルの対立する派閥間で抗争が勃発して以来、暴力が急増しているクリカンで、数千人が暴力の終結を訴えた。

articles.title: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
articles.description: With more than 90% of ballots processed early on Monday, the left-wing bloc was in front by approximately 20,000 votes.
articles.titleJa: スウェーデン総選挙、左派ブロックが僅差でリード、結果はまだ断定できず
articles.summary: スウェーデン総選挙で、90%以上の開票が完了した時点で左派ブロックが約2万票差でリード。選挙結果はまだ断定できない状況にある。

articles.title: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Africa in search of a mate
articles.description: Scientists say the record-breaking journey by three brothers offers hope wildlife can survive growing pressures.
articles.titleJa: 野生の犬がアフリカを横断し、2500マイルの交配相手探しの旅を記録
articles.summary: 科学者によると、3匹の野生犬が交配相手を求めアフリカ大陸を2500マイル移動。この記録的な旅は、野生生物が環境圧力に耐え得る希望を示すものだという。

articles.title: Body of missing runner found in South Africa
articles.description: A nationwide appeal was launched after Elizabeth Moselakgomo went missing last week. Four other women's bodies have been found nearby.
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカで行方不明のランナーの遺体を発見
articles.summary: 先週から行方不明だったエリザベス・モセラコモさんの遺体が南アフリカで発見された。近くでは他の女性4人の遺体も発見されており、全国的な捜査が開始されている。

articles.title: Zambians warned not to eat dead wildlife after anthrax kills dozens of animals
articles.description: At least 12 people are being treated for anthrax after eating infected meat from wildlife carcasses.
articles.titleJa: 炭疽病で多数の動物が死亡、ザンビア国民に死んだ野生動物を食べないよう警告
articles.summary: 炭疽病により数十匹の動物が死亡したことを受け、ザンビアでは死んだ野生動物を食べないよう警告が出された。感染肉を食べた少なくとも12人が治療を受けている。

articles.title: Hyrox apologises for allowing race to continue after athlete soils herself
articles.description: Some raised concerns around hygiene while others praised the competitor's resolve to finish the race and push through adversity.
articles.titleJa: Hyrox、選手が失禁した後もレースを続行させたことを謝罪
articles.summary: フィットネスレースHyroxが、選手が失禁したにもかかわらずレースを続行させたことについて謝罪。衛生上の懸念が上がった一方で、選手の完走への決意を称賛する声も上がった。

articles.title: Trump says he will remove all Irish whiskey tariffs as he ends two-day visit
articles.description: Whiskey distilled in the Republic of Ireland faces the standard 15% tariff which applies to EU goods entering the US.
articles.titleJa: トランプ氏、2日間の訪問を終え、アイルランド産ウイスキーの関税を全て撤廃すると表明
articles.summary: トランプ氏がアイルランドへの2日間の訪問を終え、アイルランド産ウイスキーに課せられている関税を全撤廃すると発表。現在、アイルランド産ウイスキーはEU産品として米国に輸入される際に15%の関税がかかっている。

articles.title: Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea
articles.description: Ships and helicopters are searching for those missing from the Virgo Transport 8 ship, which had encountered bad weather.
articles.titleJa: インドネシアのフェリーがジャワ海で転覆、6人死亡、130人行方不明
articles.summary: ジャワ海でフェリー「ヴィルゴ・トランスポート8」が悪天候のため転覆。6人が死亡し、130人が行方不明となっており、船舶とヘリコプターによる捜索活動が続いている。

articles.title: Trump dismisses concerns over AI dangers
articles.description: The US president said calls to slow down AI development are a "sick conspiracy," claiming that they only serve China. Market leaders have warned of the dangers of the technology's development pace.
articles.titleJa: トランプ氏、AIの危険性への懸念を一蹴
articles.summary: 米国大統領トランプ氏は、AI開発減速の要求を「病的な陰謀」と一蹴し、中国に有利に働くと主張。市場リーダーは開発ペースの危険性を警告している。

articles.title: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudis, seize crucial Red Sea islands
articles.description: Iran-backed Houthi rebels have tightened their grip on a key shipping route, capturing two strategic Red Sea islands. The closure of another global transport route is the latest ripple effect of the US war with Iran.
articles.titleJa: イエメンのフーシ派、サウジを攻撃し紅海の重要島嶼を占領
articles.summary: イランを後ろ盾とするフーシ派反乱軍が、紅海の戦略的島嶼を占領し、主要な海運ルートを掌握。米国とイランの戦争が新たな世界的な輸送ルート閉鎖を引き起こす可能性があり、波紋を広げている。

articles.title: Ukraine, Russia set for new round of US-mediated talks
articles.description: New trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US could begin in October, according to Kyiv and Moscow. Few expect a breakthrough, but Ukraine is seeking a partial de-escalation to help it get through the winter.
articles.titleJa: ウクライナ、ロシア、米国仲介の新協議を準備
articles.summary: ウクライナ、ロシア、米国による新たな三者協議が10月に始まる可能性。進展は期待薄だが、ウクライナは冬を乗り切るため部分的な情勢緩和を求めている。

articles.title: Women's Basketball World Cup: Can Germany harness a boom?
articles.description: Germany thrilled fans at the Women's Basketball World Cup. But even if this sparked a boom in the women's game, the infrastructure simply isn't ready for it.
articles.titleJa: 女子バスケットボールワールドカップ：ドイツはこのブームを活かせるか？
articles.summary: 女子バスケットボールW杯でドイツがファンを魅了。ブームが起きてもインフラが追いつかず、女子スポーツの発展には課題が残る。

articles.title: IPO 'for the people' is out of reach for many in Nigeria
articles.description: Dangote seeks $1.6 billion from investors to finance a $14.3 billion expansion and thus double the oil refinery's capacity. The offer could give millions of Nigerians a stake in the company. But who can truly afford it?
articles.titleJa: ナイジェリアで「国民のための」IPOが多くの人にとって手の届かないものに
articles.summary: ナイジェリアのダングォート社は製油所の拡張資金として16億ドルを調達。IPOは多くの国民に株式保有の機会を与えるが、経済的に余裕のない人々には手が届かない現実がある。

articles.title: Germany news: Merz urges CDU discipline as pressure grows
articles.description: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has urged his party to stay disciplined as pressure grows over his leadership. Meanwhile, Germany's homeownership rate has fallen to its lowest level in 20 years. DW has the latest.
articles.titleJa: ドイツニュース：メルツ氏、圧力高まる中でCDUに規律を促す
articles.summary: メルツ首相が指導力への圧力が高まる中、党に規律を求めた。一方、ドイツの住宅所有率は過去20年で最低水準に落ち込んでいる。

articles.title: Ukraine: AfD questions German aid, Berlin remains committed
articles.description: Emboldened by its win in Saxony-Anhalt, the far-right Alternative for Germany wants the government to change its Ukraine and Russia policies. Berlin is staying the course, but support is fading — especially in the east.
articles.titleJa: ウクライナ：AfDがドイツの援助を疑問視、ベルリンはコミットを継続
articles.summary: ドイツの極右政党AfDがウクライナとロシアに対する政府の方針変更を要求。ベルリンは現状維持の構えだが、特に東部で支援への支持が薄れている。

articles.title: The Crusades: How a medieval Holy War still shapes politics
articles.description: In 1095, the Catholic Church launched the Crusades: wars that left millions dead and whose legacy still shapes political and ideological conflicts.
articles.titleJa: 十字軍：中世の聖戦がいかにして今も政治を形作るか
articles.summary: 1095年にカトリック教会が開始した十字軍は、数百万人の死者を出した戦争であり、その遺産は今日に至るまで政治的・イデオロギー的紛争に影響を与え続けている。

articles.title: Nepal: thousands still missing as flood recovery begins
articles.description: The Himalayan nation is moving from rescue operations to recovery, facing a $4.8 billion reconstruction bill amid renewed calls for climate justice.
articles.titleJa: ネパール：洪水復旧作業が始まる中、数千人が依然行方不明
articles.summary: ヒマラヤの国ネパールは、洪水からの復旧作業を開始。数千人が行方不明のままで、48億ドルの復興費用に直面し、気候正義を求める声が改めて上がっている。

articles.title: EU leaders urge unity after Russian strike on train
articles.description: Russia's drone attack on a train near the Ukraine-Poland border has triggered EU calls to up support for Kyiv. Allies of Ukraine should show they "are not scared," said the bloc's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas.
articles.titleJa: ロシアの列車攻撃後、EU首脳らが結束を促す
articles.summary: ウクライナ・ポーランド国境近くでのロシアによる列車へのドローン攻撃を受け、EU首脳はキエフへの支援強化を呼びかけ。同盟国は「恐れていない」と示すべきだとEU外交官が発言。

articles.title: The London hospital funded by donors who invested in the slave trade
articles.description:
St Barts is one of many UK institutions whose benefactors were involved in the trafficking of enslaved Africans
Inside the Great Hall of St Bartholomew’s North Wing, alongside stately portraits of the apostle from whom London’s oldest hospital takes its name and King Henry VIII, extravagant commemorative boards adorn the walls.
The Great Hall was a grand, formal space where governors weighed their philanthropic donations and drafted their wills, many while investing in the stock of companies built on the trafficking of enslaved Africans. Today, many of those donors are commemorated in acrylic gold paint on the boards.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 奴隷貿易に投資した寄付者によって資金提供されたロンドンの病院
articles.summary: ロンドン最古の病院セント・バーツが、奴隷貿易に投資した寄付者によって資金提供されていた歴史が明らかに。英国の多くの機関が同様の過去を持つ。

articles.title: Africa’s richest man aiming to make $23bn from continent’s biggest-ever IPO
articles.description:
Public offering of Aliko Dangote’s Nigerian oil refinery business could swell his net wealth by two-thirds
The fortune of Africa’s richest person could swell by two thirds to nearly $60bn (£44bn) after his refinery in Nigeria listed publicly in the continent’s biggest-ever initial public offering.
If Monday’s flotation of Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals on the Nigerian exchange goes to plan, then Aliko Dangote will add a further $23bn (£17bn) to his $35bn net worth.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: アフリカの富豪、大陸史上最大のIPOで230億ドルを目指す
articles.summary: アフリカ最大の富豪アリコ・ダンゴテが、ナイジェリアの石油精製事業のIPOにより、純資産を230億ドル増やすことを目指す。これは大陸史上最大の新規株式公開となる。

articles.title: Burial of King Oyo takes place in Uganda as news anchor prepares for throne
articles.description:
Royal guards carry casket through streets of Fort Portal amid row over appointment of Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma
Uganda’s King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, long the world’s youngest monarch, has been buried among the tombs of his royal forebears as ⁠his Tooro kingdom looked to put ⁠a bitter succession battle behind ​it.
Oyo’s appointed successor, the news anchor Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma, cast nine coffee berries into the grave at the Karambi Royal Tombs, marking the formal handover of power in the western Ugandan kingdom.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ウガンダでオヨ王の埋葬、ニュースキャスターが王位継承へ準備
articles.summary: ウガンダで世界最年少の君主であったオヨ王の埋葬が行われ、激しい後継者争いの末、ニュースキャスターのエドワード・ルキディ・キジャナンゴマ氏が王位を継承することに。

articles.title: Six Nigerians extradited to US over $6m online romance scam
articles.description:
Alleged members of Black Axe criminal network that swindled US women out of $6m flown from South Africa
Six Nigerian nationals linked to an organized criminal network that allegedly swindled American women out of more than $6m through online romance scams were extradited to the United States on Friday.
South African police confirmed they were to be extradited earlier on Friday, while local news in Africa confirmed that the Directorate for Priority Crime Investigation, known as the Hawks, facilitated their handover to officials from the US Federal Bureau of Investigation and Secret Service at Cape Town international airport, in collaboration with Interpol South Africa.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: $15m fund launched to create ‘unstoppable momentum’ to end FGM worldwide
articles.description:
Her Horizon Fund seeks $100m to stop practice harming 230m women and girls globally  
Frontline activists and leaders in the fight against female genital mutilation, which has affected more than 230 million women and girls worldwide, have welcomed an unprecedented $15.5m (£11.4m) fund aimed at creating “unstoppable momentum” to finally end the practice.
The launch of the fund comes as women’s rights are increasingly under attack and donor funding is in sharp decline, particularly for work led by FGM survivors in local communities. It is thought to be the largest single philanthropic contribution to ending the practice of FGM.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 女性性器切除を世界中で終わらせるための「止められない勢い」を生む1500万ドル基金が発足
articles.summary: 世界で2億3千万人の女性に影響する女性性器切除(FGM)を終わらせるため、1550万ドルの基金が立ち上げられた。これはFGM根絶への「止められない勢い」を生むことを目的とする。

articles.title: Canada offers air defense support for Ukraine as Zelenskyy visits
articles.description:
Canadian PM Mark Carney hosts president in Calgary, where he grew up alongside large Ukrainian community
Canada offered support on Thursday to boost Ukraine’s air defenses and help replenish its drone stocks, as the countries pledged to deepen their alliance during a visit by Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
Mark Carney hosted the president of Ukraine in Calgary in the western province of Alberta, where the Canadian prime minister grew up among a large community of people with Ukrainian heritage.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ゼレンスキー大統領の訪問中、カナダがウクライナへの防空支援を提案
articles.summary: ゼレンスキー大統領のカナダ訪問中、カナダはウクライナへの防空支援とドローン補給を申し出た。両国は同盟関係の深化を誓う。

articles.title: Rubio signals shift to working with allies to fight drug trade as latest boat strike kills three
articles.description:
Rubio visits Ecuador and welcomes cooperation after campaign of unilateral strikes on alleged ‘narco-terrorists’
The US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, gave new clarity on the approach toward combating drug trafficking in Latin American waters, saying the Trump administration was focused on working with allied countries and aligning with their laws but insisted the military would “still blow up ships if need be”.
The public acknowledgment of a shift in US strategy comes a year after Washington began a campaign of unilateral deadly strikes against those it calls “narco-terrorists” operating boats in international waters.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ルビオ国務長官、最新の船舶攻撃で3人死亡後、同盟国との協力で麻薬取引対策へ方針転換を示唆
articles.summary: 米国務長官マルコ・ルビオは、最新の船舶攻撃で3人が死亡したことを受け、麻薬取引対策で同盟国との協力重視へと方針転換を示唆した。

articles.title: Notorious Ecuadorian crime gang designated a terrorist group by US
articles.description:
Trump administration to seek extra funding from Congress to ‘dismantle’ Los Tiguerones over narcotics trafficking
The US has designated Ecuador’s Los Tiguerones gang, which stormed a television station during a live broadcast in 2024, as a terrorist organisation as the Trump administration expands its campaign against narcotics traffickers it says are destabilising Latin America.
The US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, made the announcement in Quito, where he met Ecuadorian president Daniel Noboa, one of several rightwing allies of Donald Trump whom Rubio is courting as a security partner during a three-nation tour through Latin America that began on Tuesday.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 悪名高いエクアドルの犯罪組織が米国によりテロリスト集団に指定される
articles.summary: 米国は、テレビ局を襲撃したエクアドルの悪名高い犯罪組織「ロス・ティグエロネス」をテロリスト集団に指定した。米国は中南米での麻薬密売対策を強化している。

articles.title: Family of British man found dead in Grenada ask local police to work with UK investigators
articles.description:
Andrew Frederick’s body was found in property he was staying at in Grenada in January
The family of a British father who was found dead in the Caribbean in January is urging authorities in Grenada to work with UK police to uncover the truth about his death.
Andrew Frederick’s body was found in the property he was staying at in Grenada on 4 January. An autopsy, performed in the same week by a privately hired pathologist, concluded that the 47-year-old’s death was a homicide.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: グレナダで死亡した英国人男性の家族、現地警察に英国捜査官との協力を要請
articles.summary: グレナダで死亡した英国人男性アンドリュー・フレデリックの家族が、現地警察に対し、英国捜査官との協力で彼の死の真相を解明するよう求めている。検死では殺人と断定された。

articles.title: ‘It’s hell’: father of slain Australian surfers tells Mexico homicide trial about identifying sons’ bodies
articles.description:
Three men are on trial over the death of brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend, US citizen Jack Carter Rhoad, in Ensenada
The father of two Australian surfers killed in Mexico two years ago testified in court on Tuesday that his life had been turned into hell, as the high-profile trial continued into its second day.
Three men are charged in the killing of Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson, aged 30 and 33, respectively, and their 30-year-old American friend Jack Carter Rhoad, who were on a surfing trip to Mexico’s Pacific coast in April 2024.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「地獄だ」：殺害されたオーストラリア人サーファーの父親、メキシコの殺人裁判で息子たちの遺体確認について語る
articles.summary: メキシコで殺害されたオーストラリア人サーファーの父親が、公判で息子たちの遺体確認時の「地獄」を証言した。3人の男性がこの事件で裁判にかけられている。

articles.title: 12 European nations call on EU to expand Arctic presence amid growing threats
articles.description: Speaking to reporters on Monday, Kaja Kallas, the EU's top diplomat, said the bloc had to remain "vigilant" in the face of increasing Russian military activity in the Arctic, as well as China's growing interest in the region.
articles.titleJa: 12の欧州諸国、増大する脅威の中でEUに北極圏でのプレゼンス拡大を要求
articles.summary: EUの上級外交官は、ロシアの軍事活動と中国の関心増大を受け、EUが北極圏での警戒を維持し、プレゼンスを拡大する必要があると述べた。12の欧州諸国がこの方針を支持している。

articles.title: Party leaders of Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland say future belongs back in EU
articles.description: The main parties from each nation want to break away from the UK but have different positions on how and when this might take place.
articles.titleJa: スコットランド、ウェールズ、北アイルランドの党首らが「未来はEUに帰属する」と表明
articles.summary: スコットランド、ウェールズ、北アイルランドの主要政党が、イギリスからの離脱とEUへの復帰を望んでいるが、その方法と時期については異なる立場を取っている。

articles.title: 'We were right': EU finally listening to Baltic warnings on Russia, Latvian PM says
articles.description: The Latvian PM noted that the Baltics' sense of foreboding over Russian attacks on the EU come from their occupation. "We know the tricks; we knew the bully would show its muscles."
articles.titleJa: 「我々は正しかった」：EU、ついにバルト諸国のロシアに関する警告に耳を傾ける、ラトビア首相が発言
articles.summary: ラトビア首相は、バルト諸国がロシアのEUに対する攻撃を予感していたのは、過去の占領経験に基づくものであり、EUがようやく彼らの警告に耳を傾けていると述べた。

articles.title: 'Come witness the fitness. It shall be a sight to behold': Oasis announce 38 new dates for global tour in 2027
articles.description: "Today is gonna be the day..." Fans of the Manchester rock band get an eagerly anticipated fresh round of shows, after their massive Oasis: Live '25 reunion tour...
articles.titleJa: 「その雄姿を見よ。圧巻の光景となるだろう」：オアシス、2027年のワールドツアー38公演追加を発表
articles.summary: マンチェスター出身のロックバンド、オアシスが2027年のワールドツアーで新たに38公演を追加することを発表し、ファンは熱狂的な期待を寄せている。

articles.title: State of the Union: Did von der Leyen make good on last year's promises?
articles.description: Did Ursula von der Leyen deliver on all the promises she made in last year's State of the Union speech? Euronews puts her work to the test.
articles.titleJa: 欧州連合の現状：フォン・デア・ライエンは昨年の公約を果たしたか？
articles.summary: 欧州委員会委員長のウルズラ・フォン・デア・ライエンが、昨年の欧州連合の現状に関する演説で交わした公約をどれだけ果たしたか、その成果が検証される。

articles.title: 35,959 flights a day: Europe saw record summer air traffic despite Middle East war
articles.description: The conflict has seen a large increase in flights to countries including Albania, Croatia, Cyprus, Greece, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia and Slovenia as Europeans choose holiday destinations closer to home.
articles.titleJa: 1日35,959便：中東戦争にもかかわらず、ヨーロッパは記録的な夏の航空交通量を記録
articles.summary: 中東での紛争にもかかわらず、ヨーロッパでは夏に記録的な航空交通量を記録した。欧州の人々がアルバニア、クロアチアなど近場の休暇先を選ぶ傾向が見られた。

articles.title: Parliament pushes tougher energy permit deadlines, setting up clash with EU countries

articles.title: World Trade & Tech Day: AI and trade increasingly intertwined

The event shone a spotlight on how AI and frontier technologies are making international trade more efficient, bringing together government leaders as well as academics and private sector representatives to discuss ways to harness AI's potential into tangible economic gains and an engine for inclusive growth.

articles.title: Trade finance: how volatile financial conditions influence its availability and impact trade levels

In addition, the level of development of local financial markets influences the supply of trade finance by global institutions.
